answer: Use randomized audit bonds with cluster-limited work seats. 1) Each fresh key locks 74 POA for 30 days and signs a task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established reviewers from unrelated funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied outputs, or synchronized payouts merge keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Like ivory carried through a grove of ferrous roots, each worker leaves one trail; aliases cannot multiply its weight.
